name: morph-popover
title: Morph Popover
description: Open the feedback button to leave a comment
useCases: A reader spots an error in the docs and sends feedback from a small form beside the article.
During a mockup review, a designer leaves a short comment. If the service is unavailable, they retry from the same form.
task: Open the feedback button to leave a comment
behavior: onSubmit receives the text and can return a Promise. Reject it on delivery failure to show the retry state.
